name: Amulet
long_description:
Amulet is a high-performance filesystem that gives agent workloads fast access to petabytes of data stored in the cloud. 

We provide isolated, writable workspaces that mount in under 100 ms and fork without copying data. Work persists across disposable compute, and every workspace can be snapshotted, reproduced, merged, or rolled back. We’re working with agentic automated-research labs, cloud agent providers, and other to bring this infrastructure to data-intensive AI teams.
one_liner: High performance file system for agents
